observations: Three photos show a black electronic keyboard with 61 keys, placed on artificial green grass.
The keyboard has a central control panel with multiple buttons, sliders, and a small display screen.
The keys are white and black, standard piano-style layout.
The front panel includes speaker grilles on both sides and a vertical vent on the right.
The keyboard appears to be an older model, likely from the 1980s or 1990s, with a retro design.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos, but the surface is slightly dusty and the lighting is even, possibly from a flash.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not be functional (e.g., keys not working, no sound, or internal damage).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard powered on, keys being pressed, and sound output.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos (e.g., cracked circuit board, dead keys).
risks.proof: A close-up video of the keys being pressed and the sound produced, and a test of all buttons and sliders.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be missing accessories (e.g., power adapter, stand, or manuals).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a note to confirm functionality.
Close-up video of all keys and buttons being pressed to check for responsiveness.
Photo of all included accessories (power adapter, stand, manuals, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
